review.evidence: At block 26110197, exhaustive native role-event replay and hasRole checks establish two default-admin EOAs (0x407374be435ed278fca44be695d32f0230fe46e3, 0x5c943b2b881af70af571098a228d92cbcc2b5ba2) and two delegated MINTER_ROLE EOAs (0x7ba63cdc16abfbe4838eee04aff4150749a21bd8, 0xb99123ccab3e0110742cede9271953c6803947d4). No other explicit role grants occur; default administrators inherit all roles. Verified source establishes immediate UUPS upgrades and unbounded native minting. The on-chain census is closed; organizational identity, human independence and key-custody policies are not publicly attested. Organizational ownership, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policies of the four identified EOA controllers are not publicly attested. Primary documents independently verified on 2026-10-04 establish a two-leg whole-fund reconciliation: the 14 September 2026 prospectus, Schedule 6 printed pages 131-132, requires the Administrator to match the complete official book-entry tokenized-share register and ownership to blockchain Tokens on the Ethereum-based Digital Platform at least daily when triggered by a transaction, with independent Manager verification using per-custody-account token reports; its Financial Reports section requires annual audited reports within four months of 31 December and semi-annual reports within two months of 30 June. The KPMG report signed 29 April 2026 audits the USD sub-fund's all-class assets and liabilities for the period ending 31 December 2025. The 30 June 2026 interim report dated 28 August 2026 enumerates all USD share classes A/B/F/I and Listed Class, including CUMIU Class I USD, and states USD603,917,339 assets = USD552,517 nonshare liabilities + USD603,364,822 net assets attributable to shareholders. Daily full token-to-register matching joined to recurring same-fund all-class asset/liability reports supports periodic reconciliation, not continuous live chain assurance. The interim report is unaudited; KPMG assurance covers 2025 year-end, not current token RPCs, and rounded displayed share counts times NAVs are not an exact supply-proof balance. Nominee end-client allocations are not visible to the fund, although distributor-level legal shares are counted; no separately issued bridge/wrapper population is established or covered. The SFC's registered OFC product list, independently queried on 2026-10-04, identifies ChinaAMC Digital OFC BVQ025, ChinaAMC USD Digital Money Market Fund BWG918 and manager China Asset Management (Hong Kong) Limited, with USD sub-fund authorisation dated 2 July 2025. SFO section 104 authorisation and SFC circular 26EC22 of 20 April 2026 impose ongoing investment, operational and ownership-record obligations on this exact issuing fund and product provider, including SFC-requested third-party tokenisation/smart-contract verification, supporting prudential supervision. This does not rely on HKMA custodian supervision or imply SFC endorsement, guaranteed backing or on-chain mint restrictions.
